description: Erection of a single storey side extension to include a replacement front entrance door to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (7 CLEM S001  Received:  05 July 2022;  7 CLEM 001 (Rev A)  Received:  13 May 2022;  Unreferenced Existing Location Plan; Unreferenced Proposed Location Plan  Received:  06 May 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey side extension hereby approved.
